videos.youtube_title: No IELTS, No Korean Student Visa | What the Embassy Actually Requires | #pakistanistudents
videos.youtube_description:
Can you get a Korean student visa without IELTS or TOEFL? No. The Embassy of the Republic of Korea lists an English language certificate among the required documents for a D-2 student visa.

In this video I explain what the requirement actually says, why some students are told otherwise, and what happens to an application submitted without it.

Official source — Embassy of the Republic of Korea to Pakistan:
https://overseas.mofa.go.kr/pk-en/brd/m_3158/view.do?seq=755072&page=1

If you are planning to apply for the Spring 2027 intake, book your test now. The Embassy’s intensive review period runs 1 December to 31 January, and an incomplete application in that window cannot be resubmitted until February.

I’m Aqib. I came from Pakistan, I’m doing my Master’s at Kyungdong University in South Korea, and I work at KUAC (Korean Universities Admission Center). I help students apply directly, with no consultation fee.

videos.youtube_title: Cost Breakdown: KDU, CKU, KBU & Songgok | Study in Korea with Zero Consultation Fee | #pakistani
videos.youtube_description:
What does it actually cost to study at KUAC’s partner universities in South Korea? In this video I go through all four — Kyungdong University Global, Catholic Kwandong University, Korean Bible University and Songgok University — with the full breakdown for each.

Covered in this video:
• Tuition per semester at each university
• How your IELTS score sets your scholarship tier
• Dormitory, visa processing and airport pickup costs
• Why applying through a local consultant costs you more
• How to check an invoice before you pay it

The part most students miss: whichever consultant you go through in Pakistan, your application still reaches KUAC. The processing happens here regardless. Going direct simply removes the extra fee in between.

I’ll handle your admission personally, with no consultation fee.

A word of caution — I have personally seen two invoices that had been edited before reaching the student. Always request the receipt directly from the university or from KUAC, and never accept a figure that someone has typed up for you.

I’m Aqib. I came from Pakistan, I’m doing my Master’s at Kyungdong University in South Korea, and I work at KUAC (Korean Universities Admission Center).
